turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You already use verbs for today, like I cook or I clean. For the past, the verb changes.
Watch: Every day I cook. Yesterday I ___. The action is finished, so I add -ed: Yesterday I cooked.
The rule: for a finished action, add -ed to most verbs.
Right: Last night she cleaned the car. Wrong: Last night she clean the car.
Now you. Write the sentence with the right verb:
Yesterday they (paint) the wall.
